risks.risk: Some keys may be dead or have intermittent contact (seller says none, but photo cannot confirm).
risks.proof: A short video showing the keyboard powered on with a key-by-key test (or at least multiple octaves) and the LCD responding while pressing every key.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst case: treat as having possible dead keys until proven.

risks.risk: Sound output may crackle/distort or speakers may be faulty (seller says no crackle).
risks.proof: A video clip playing several notes and chords at low and medium volume, ideally with the built-in speakers audible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible crackle/distortion until proven.

risks.risk: Adapter may be missing or wrong voltage/polarity (seller says adapter included).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter label/specs (voltage/amp) and a shot showing it connected to the keyboard while powering on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not guaranteed (buyer may need to source one).

risks.risk: Model number may be different from PSR-175 (panel text not fully readable).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model label/number on the keyboard (bottom or back panel) and a clear shot of the front model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for the closest PSR-series keyboard shown, assuming possible mismatch.

risks.risk: LCD/backlight or controls may be partially faulty (screen present but not verified).
risks.proof: A powered-on photo/video showing the LCD clearly and navigating menus/buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Price as LCD/control functions not fully verified.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the model label/number (front panel and/or bottom/back) to confirm PSR-175 exactly.
Video: power on + LCD visible + play test across the full keyboard range.
Video: demonstrate multiple buttons/controls (styles/voices/tempo) and show LCD changes.
Photo of the adapter and its specs, plus a shot/video showing it powering the keyboard.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact PSR-175 model and the seller’s 'working perfectly' claims (all keys/buttons, no crackle, adapter included) are not verifiable from photo 0 alone. Request powered-on and test videos plus a clear model/adapter proof before pricing.
